## Load Packages
```{r, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(here) 
library(readxl) 
library(dplyr) 
library(purrr) 
library(janitor) 
library(tibble)
```


## Load Data and Combine Into One Dataset
```{r}
# Sets a directory for functions to pull all data together
data_dir <- here("data", "raw_data")
files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
# Double checks how many files are in the data directory
cat("Excel files found:", length(files), "\n")

read_kv_sheet <- function(path, sheet) { 
  raw <- read_excel( path, sheet = sheet, col_names = c("key", "value"))
  raw <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(key))
  keys <- gsub(":$", "", raw$key) 
  keys <- make_clean_names(keys)
  vals <- as.list(raw$value)
  names(vals) <- keys
  as_tibble(vals) 
  }

read_one_file <- function(path) { 
  meta1 <- read_kv_sheet( path, sheet = "Sheet1" ) 
  meta3 <- read_kv_sheet( path, sheet = "Sheet3" )
  meta <- bind_cols( meta1, meta3, .name_repair = "unique" )
  test_data <- read_excel( path, sheet = "Sheet2" ) %>% clean_names() 
  test_data <- test_data %>% 
    mutate( source_file = basename(path))
  meta_repeated <- meta[ rep(1, nrow(test_data)), , drop = FALSE ] 
  test_data %>% 
    bind_cols(meta_repeated)
  }

results <- map( files, function(f) { 
  tryCatch( list( ok = TRUE, data = read_one_file(f), file = f, error = NA_character_ ), 
            error = function(e) { list( ok = FALSE, data = NULL, file = f, error = conditionMessage(e)) 
              } 
            ) 
  })

successful <- results %>% keep(~ .x$ok)

failed <- results %>% 
  keep(~ !.x$ok) %>%
  map_dfr( ~ tibble( file = basename(.x$file), error = .x$error ))

bad_files <- successful %>%
  map("data") %>%
  keep(~ !is.numeric(.x$vo2max)) %>%
  map_chr(~ unique(.x$source_file))

bad_files

successful %>%
  map("data") %>%
  keep(~ !is.numeric(.x$vo2max)) %>%
  map(~ distinct(.x, source_file, vo2max))

all_data <- successful %>% 
  map("data") %>% 
  bind_rows()

write.csv(all_data, here("data", "combined_tests.csv"), row.names = F)
```
